contract:
NEW src/components/mobile/EditPostSheet.tsx ("use client"):
`export function EditPostSheet({ postId, initialContent, hasMedia, nested = false, onClose, onSaved }: { postId: string; initialContent: string; hasMedia: boolean; nested?: boolean; onClose: () => void; onSaved: (p: EditedPost) => void })` (EditedPost from @/lib/posts/edit).

Structure and styling:
- vaul `<Drawer.Root open nested={nested} dismissible={!dirty && !saving} onOpenChange={(o)=>{ if(!o) onClose(); }}>`. Overlay zIndex 10400, Content zIndex 10401, maxHeight "85dvh", cream #FAF7F2, rounded top 20, safe-area bottom padding. Layers and nesting follow SharePostSheet.tsx:61-62 and :196-243.
- Drawer.Content gets `onClick={(e)=>e.stopPropagation()}` and `onPointerDown={(e)=>e.stopPropagation()}`. Both host cards are `<button onClick>` (CampusMobile.tsx:974-976 handleCardClick; ProfileMobile.tsx:2268-2270 onTap), and React bubbles through portals, so without this typing would open the viewer or double-tap-like.
- Top row: left "Cancel"; centered `<Drawer.Title>` "Edit post" (Fraunces 800 16px); right "Save" (coral #FF5C35, 800).
- Save is disabled when !dirty, invalid or saving, and reads "Saving…" while saving.

Textarea and hints:
- autoFocus, fontSize 16 (iOS zoom), minHeight 160, `value={draft}`, `onChange={e=>setDraft(e.target.value.slice(0, 2000))}`.
- placeholder: hasMedia ? "Write a caption…" : "Say something…"
- `bindMentionPicker(ta)` on mount (src/lib/composer/helpers.ts:101).
- Counter `{draft.length}/2000`, same format as PostComposerMobile.tsx:506.
- When hasMedia, a note: "You can change the words. The photo or video stays."
- When !hasMedia and draft.trim()==="", a hint: "Your post can't be empty."
- `dirty = draft.trim() !== initialContent.trim()`.
- Cancel with dirty: `window.confirm("Discard your changes?")`; false keeps the sheet open.

Save:
- `const r = await vibeRequest<{ post?: unknown }>(`/api/posts/${postId}`, { method: "PATCH", json: { content: draft }, failure: "Couldn't save your changes." })`.
- On ok with `editedPostFrom(r.data.post)` non-null: `onSaved(p); toast({ message: "Post updated", tone: "info" }); onClose();`.
- On failure: keep the sheet and draft and re-enable Save (vibeRequest already toasted; 403 terms_required shows "Accept the Terms first, then try again." with the Review Terms action).

PostViewerMobile.tsx:
- PostDetail (:47-60): add `edited_at?: string | null;`
- Props (:93-110): add `onEdited?: (p: EditedPost) => void;` with a doc comment saying the caller patches its own list in place.
- State next to :137-138: `const [editOpen, setEditOpen] = useState(false);`
- Menu, owner block (:636-645): insert BEFORE Delete `<ViewerMenuItem label="Edit post" disabled={!post} onClick={() => { setMenuOpen(false); setEditOpen(true); }} />`. Non-owners keep Report (:614) and never see Edit.
- Header sub-line (:525): append `${post?.edited_at ? " · Edited" : ""}` after relTime.
- Next to the SharePostSheet mount (:952): `{editOpen && post ? <EditPostSheet nested postId={postId} initialContent={post.content ?? ""} hasMedia={!!post.media_url} onClose={() => setEditOpen(false)} onSaved={(p) => { setPost(prev => prev ? { ...prev, content: p.content, tags: p.tags, edited_at: p.edited_at } : prev); onEdited?.(p); }} /> : null}`
- Body (:712-723) and tag chips re-render from `post`, so the update is in place.

src/app/posts/[id]/PostPageClient.tsx needs NO change: the viewer updates itself.

DEPENDS ON E1.
acceptance: 375x812, signed in, /posts/<own post id>: ⋯ shows Send to chats, Copy link, Edit post, Delete post. On someone else's post: Send to chats, Copy link, Report post, and no Edit.

Edit post opens a sheet titled "Edit post" above the viewer. Save stays disabled until the text changes. Saving updates the body text and #chips in place, adds " · Edited" to the header line, toasts "Post updated", and a reload shows the same.
Text-only post cleared to spaces: Save disabled and "Your post can't be empty." shown. Image post: the note shows and an empty caption saves.

In-page fetch override returning 403 {ok:false,code:"terms_required"} for the PATCH: the toast reads "Accept the Terms first, then try again." and the sheet stays open with the draft (no prod write needed).
iOS Safari: closing the sheet leaves the viewer full-screen with no page jump behind it (nested scroll lock); textarea focus does not zoom.
Swipe-down / overlay tap does nothing while the draft is dirty; Cancel asks "Discard your changes?".
